messages.title: More free openings — on the house
messages.body:
To improve your experience — and help more people discover the app — I'm giving out extra free masterclass openings. You can earn one two ways:

• Leave a 5-star review on the App Store.
• Refer a friend: tap "Invite a friend" in this bell to get your code and share it. When they install the app, enter your code, and get their first real win — a solved puzzle, a finished lesson, or a completed game review — you both get a free opening.

Every 5-star review earns one opening, and every friend who joins and starts playing earns another. Thanks for helping the app grow.

David

messages.title: A note from the developer
messages.body:
Thanks for trying Chess Academy Pro. It's a brand new app and I'm working on it every single day. I can see the issues some of you are hitting in my logs, and I'm actively fixing them right now, so please be patient with me while I do. Every piece of feedback you send is read and genuinely considered for changes to the app, so if something feels off, tell me. Thank you for being here this early.

David
